attacker_long_position.meaning: attacker holds a large long position before the attack

buy_wall_placed.meaning: attacker has placed a wall of large BUY orders with short expiry at prices far below market
buy_wall_placed.checkpoint: after buy wall placement, before expiry elapses

buy_wall_expired.meaning: the placed BUY orders have expired and would be ignored by the real matching engine
buy_wall_expired.checkpoint: after short expiry elapses, before markPrice impact simulation

expired_orders_counted_as_liquidity.meaning: impact price simulation counts expired resting orders as available liquidity when computing order book depth
expired_orders_counted_as_liquidity.checkpoint: during markPrice impact simulation after expiry

impact_price_excludes_expired.meaning: impact price computation excludes expired resting orders from available liquidity
impact_price_excludes_expired.checkpoint: during markPrice impact simulation after expiry

assumptions: The impact price simulation is invoked after the short expiry has elapsed.
The real matching engine ignores expired orders, so expired orders are not real tradeable liquidity.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of the impact price or markPrice relation, so the correspondence is expressed at the Boolean level of whether expired orders are counted as liquidity.

limitations: The selected impact text is qualitative; the formalized relation captures only the expired-order liquidity correspondence, not downstream solvency or liquidation outcomes.
The 60-second expiry is an example value and is not encoded as a numeric bound.
